64 preset dictionaries are compiled from the open data sources below. OpenMDict converted each of them to MDict and modified it (reformatted as HTML, lookup keys and redirects added); each .mdx names its source, copyright holders, license and modifications in its description, which the app shows in the dictionary's info screen. License ids are SPDX identifiers; LicenseRef-* ids are explained under License texts.

• Bible — King James Version: Public domain outside the United Kingdom. In the UK the King James Version is under perpetual Crown copyright: printing requires letters patent (held by Cambridge University Press, Oxford University Press and Collins), as the eBible.org eng-kjv rights statement notes. • Bíblia Sagrada — Almeida 1911: Text: João Ferreira d’Almeida, Revista e Corrigida (Lisbon, 1911 printing of the 1900 edition), from Project Gutenberg eBook #62383, labelled “Public domain in the USA” there; Markdown structuring by mazza/biblia-arc1911 (CC0 1.0). • 官話和合譯本聖經（繁體）: Text: Chinese Union Version (官話和合譯本, 1919), from Chinese Wikisource, marked public domain there. • 官话和合译本圣经（简体）: Text: Chinese Union Version (官話和合譯本, 1919), from Chinese Wikisource, marked public domain there; converted to Simplified Chinese with OpenCC. • 文語訳聖書: Text: 文語訳 (明治元訳 Old Testament, 1887; 大正改訳 New Testament, 1917), from the CrossWire SWORD module JapBungo 2.0, distributed by CrossWire as Public Domain. • 성경 (개역한글): Text: Korean Revised Version (개역한글판; Korean Bible Society, 1961), distributed as Public Domain by CrossWire (KorRV 2.0.1).
